shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan sits at the shelf-side window seat and asks a question about the game, a man in a mustard sweater sits at the doorway-side window seat, a woman in a burgundy hoodie sits at the shelf-side aisle seat, and a man in an emerald polo sits at the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in a mustard sweater leaves the doorway-side window seat and exits the venue. The woman in a navy cardigan asks a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in an emerald polo asks a question. The woman in a navy cardigan answers.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
